system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a Kubernetes ServiceMonitor manifest (prometheus-operator) instructing Prometheus to scrape metrics from a Service named 'api-metrics' on port 9090 every 30 seconds.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Kubernetes manifest (YAML)

Task: Write a Kubernetes ServiceMonitor manifest (prometheus-operator) instructing Prometheus to scrape metrics from a Service named 'api-metrics' on port 9090 every 30 seconds.

Output only the Kubernetes manifest (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: api-metrics
  namespace: monitoring
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: api-metrics
    app.kubernetes.io/component: metrics
    release: prometheus
spec:
  jobLabel: app.kubernetes.io/name
  namespaceSelector:
    matchNames:
      - default
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: api-metrics
  endpoints:
    - port: "9090"
      path: /metrics
      interval: 30s
      scrapeTimeout: 10s
      scheme: http
      honorLabels: false
      honorTimestamps: true
      metricRelabelings:
        - sourceLabels: [__name__]
          regex: 'go_gc_.*|process_.*'
          action: keep
      relabelings:
        - sourceLabels: [__meta_kubernetes_namespace]
          targetLabel: namespace
        - sourceLabels: [__meta_kubernetes_service_name]
          targetLabel: service
        - sourceLabels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
          targetLabel: pod
        - sourceLabels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_node_name]
          targetLabel: node
